key.name: dim
key.summary: Darkening over the video on the login screen
key.description: Black laid over the video behind the login dialog, from 0 (none) to 1, to match a login theme that darkens its wallpaper.

key.name: settle
key.summary: Slow the video to a stop when the password is accepted
key.description: Hold the session start while the video slows to a stop (settle-delay-ms, then settle-ramp-ms), then make the frame it stopped on the desktop picture. False signs in at once and leaves the desktop picture as it was.
